So I would like you to improve this.
And then I also want you to work on some interesting features because you know we are using Pexel API to generate image.
So what about generating the image also in parallel while we are creating the
spec and the home page? And once we start with the image, maybe show them little by
little by introducing them with a scale effect with opacity going on. And then at
the end when the home page will appear we would like to transition those image
automatically to the place where they are actually on the homepage. So work
on that seriously and it will be stunning!
